behavior: Daemon claim and owner-local fleet public custody admission require explicit external declarations and preprovisioned snapshot anchors.
Claim reserve pressure remains on the same owner; an uncertain publisher joins/closes and may reopen only exact pending bytes, at most three generations per controller lifetime.
Claim replay checks actual retained signed bytes after finalized RPC and before send; a published Prepared callback that loses acknowledgement still retains the shared nonce floor.
A terminal claim-swarm member does not cancel healthy members, while explicit parent cancellation joins all.
Fleet and claim missing retained members cannot silently initialize fresh lifetime history; original signed JSON/RLP bytes remain unchanged.
causal_scope: Replay: exact old replay function body from retained intermediate source, with the current unused owner parameter.
Swarm: exact old Run body with only required fixture-context forwarding and an observer after its original campaign cancel; not a clean historical whole-program build.
Prepared nonce floor: retained actual intermediate source before the correction, with the post-real-sync observer; fails floor0 in normal/race.
Earlier two-root lost-member census normal failure is retained separately; no race rerun claimed for that historical census.
limits: 201 selected fleet/claim/miner admission roots and3 inherited subtests per mode, plus package vet; not full miner/provider, full SN, release composition, live chain or device qualification.
Author execution only; independent source rerun remains separate.
Snapshot/native primitives retain their separate author and independent scopes; monitor18dc and sibling validator/root/server adoption are excluded.
No signing/broadcasting to a live network, service deployment or production start occurred; synthetic tests capture generated bytes locally.
Production preparation, owner-xattr backup/restore, capacity forecasting/rotation, deployment units and live authority remain separate open work.
The three-generation controller budget is per process lifetime; no anti-rollback proof against replay of all predecessor bytes and local authority.
preserved_failures: Original ab7 full normal: two fixture defects (alternate RPC fixture changed the declared state path; provisional runtime fixture lacked a real RPC/SCALE-committed header).
98ff fixture successor: only provisional header fixture still failed. Both corrected in separate commits; no production authority check was relaxed.
First successor wrapper failed to write its terminal wrapper-exit variable; raw phase command/JSON/stderr/exit and result remain authoritative. Qualified wrapper has terminal0.
